title: Breakdown
lyrics_synced:
[00:00.00] Sequenced by Blake Wallace
[00:18.62] I breakdown in the middle and lose my thread.
[00:24.83] No one can understand a word that I say.
[00:29.48] When I breakdown just a little and lose my head,
[00:35.86] Nothing I try to do can work the same way.
[00:41.67] Any time it happened, I'd get over it
[00:44.51] With a little help from all my friends.
[00:52.71] Anybody else could see what's wrong with me,
[00:55.54] But they walk away and just pretend...
[01:02.41] When I breakdown.
[01:35.86] I breakdown in the middle and lose my thread.
[01:42.07] No one can understand a word that I say.
[01:46.72] When I breakdown just a little and lose my head,
[01:53.10] Nothing I try to do can work the same way.
[01:58.28] Where are all the friends who used to talk to me?
[02:01.75] All they ever told me was good news...
[02:09.31] People that I've never seen are kind to me,
[02:12.78] Is it any wonder I'm confused?
[02:19.66] When I breakdown... When I breakdown...
[02:52.74] When I breakdown...
[03:03.78] Freedom, freedom, we will not obey.
[03:14.86] Freedom, freedom, take the wall away.
[03:25.83] Take the wall away.
[03:31.29] Freedom, freedom, we will not obey.
[03:42.44] Freedom, freedom, take the wall away.
[03:53.47] Where are all my friends?
[03:59.01] I'm so confused...
